integrity: The proof is analytic. Exact finite-state replay is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite-dimensional or all-parameter certificate.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the earliest reachable time \(t=w\).
The classical comparator is the simple coordinate walk, not a repeatedly measured Grover walk.
The exponential crossover does not resolve the subexponential critical window at \(\rho=e/4\).
title: Exact first-arrival frontier and the \(e/4\) interference crossover for the Grover walk on the hypercube
